selected.boundary: Reject node:local fallback, inherited auth, unmanaged shell, telemetry, implicit SSH -t and arbitrary relative execution files.

Output prompt regex is never proof of child exit, session completion, authorization or dispatch success.

authority_profile.safe: existing registered executable only, no widening
authority_profile.full_user: new executor requires independent local lease and fresh SOFT per-action approval after implementation

security_notes: Job Objects supervise descendant processes but do not by themselves restrict user-level network or filesystem side effects.
Bound process output separately and return explicit truncation; do not fabricate complete streams.
Consent/lease/revoke/epoch applies at every mutation boundary; uncertain dispatch never auto-retries.
